acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with load and counts; the control readiness wait tolerates load or reports a distinct timeout; one mutation proving the fix.
body: Observed 2026-10-15 by the V1-1411 lane (PR #923, BASE 778bfcd3d), no CPU burners. TestMCPFlowsCoverageRefusesAMissingPromisorObjectWithoutFetching and TestMCPCEMReportRefusesAMissingCitedBlobWithAValidMapWithoutFetching failed with 'control ... did not serve READY: repository-unavailable' at load ~45; both passed on targeted rerun at load ~40. Likely a readiness deadline in the control fixture.
title: internal/mcp/bridge refusal controls fail under load: control did not serve READY: repository-unavailable
